rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for damaging or ruining something so it no longer works or is desirable.

example.traditional: 我唔小心整壞咗部電腦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 waai6 zo2 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this specifically when food or another substance goes bad by itself.

example.english: Ice cream will spoil if you leave it out too long.
example.traditional: 啲雪糕放耐咗就會變壞。
example.jyutping: di1 syut3 gou1 fong3 noi6 zo2 zau6 wui5 bin3 waai6

rows.note: Use this for revealing important plot details or an ending before someone has experienced the story.

example.jyutping: m4 hou2 kek6 tau3 tou3 hei3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when excessive indulgence or pampering ruins someone's character or habits.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 cung2 waai6 go3 zai2
